title: Choosing a Gift for a Friend Moving Away

characters.goal: Suggest making a custom photo album full of shared memories.

characters.goal: Suggest giving a warm fleece blanket or a nice scented candle.

characters.role: A friend who suggests a travel backpack.
characters.goal: Propose a sturdy backpack or luggage tag for their journey.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1

dialogue.text: Those are both thoughtful, but what about something practical for traveling?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: And I will start printing out all our favorite photos right away.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Perfect! Our friend is going to love it.

title: Returning a Defective Item
situation: Two friends go to an electronics store service counter with a friendly store employee to exchange a malfunctioning blender.

characters.role: A customer who bought the blender.
characters.goal: Explain that the blender power button stopped working after one day.

characters.role: A friend supporting the customer.
characters.goal: Show the store receipt and confirm when the item was purchased.

characters.role: A helpful store employee.
characters.goal: Examine the item, check the warranty, and offer a replacement or refund.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Hello! I would like to return this blender I bought yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: Hello! Sure, I can help you with that. What seems to be the problem?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Explain that the blender button stopped turning on when plugged in.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Hand the paper store receipt to the employee and confirm the purchase date.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: Inspect the receipt and offer to swap it for a brand new blender in stock.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: An exchange for a brand new one would be wonderful, thank you!

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: Ask if the new blender comes with a standard manufacturer warranty.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: Yes, it has a full one-year warranty included in the box.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: Hand over the new sealed box and print out a fresh store receipt.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Thank you so much for your prompt help today!

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
dialogue.text: We really appreciate how quick and smooth that was.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: You are very welcome! Have a great afternoon!

title: Asking for Directions in a Shopping Mall

characters.goal: Explain which store you are searching for and ask where it is located.

characters.role: A shopper looking for the food court.
characters.goal: Ask if the bookstore is near the main food court area.

characters.role: A helpful security guard.
characters.goal: Provide clear step-by-step directions using mall landmarks.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Excuse me, officer! Could you help us find a store?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_3
dialogue.text: Of course! I know this mall very well. What are you looking for?

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_1
dialogue.text: Ask where the main bookstore is located on this floor.

dialogue.speaker: PLAYER_2
